scenario: A person plans to keep a phone for about five years and wants one case that still looks acceptable and protects properly in year four. Previous transparent cases yellowed, a leather case wore out at the corners, and a soft-touch case became gummy. The available material includes one current clear PC-and-TPU listing with anti-yellow and drop-protection claims, general material-degradation explanations, and owner observations whose actual durations range from more than one year to about three years plus imprecise reports of use for years.
target: Explain why clear PC-and-TPU cases, leather cases, and soft-touch polyurethane surfaces can age differently, while keeping formulation and general mechanisms separate from a product lifetime claim. Audit the seller statements and every owner report at its real duration and model scope, decide whether any specific case is actually supported as both presentable and protective in year four, and give a conditional purchase and long-term inspection plan when the evidence is insufficient.
